name: RunAnywhere
long_description: RunAnywhere runs open-weight models at full speed wherever a company needs them. Wally is our inference stack for open models: serverless inference, BYOC, or on-prem, so code and data never leave their network. One command puts a Wally-served model inside Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, etc. When a model fits on the device, the same tooling runs it locally through our open-source SDKs for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web, built on kernels written by our agentic harness for Apple and Qualcomm silicon (10K+ GitHub stars).
one_liner: Fastest inference anywhere: open models on-prem, hosted or on-device

launches.title: Wally by RunAnywhere: The fastest inference for open frontier models
launches.tagline: Open-weight frontier models at real-time speed for voice and agent products, live on day one. Serverless, BYOC or on-prem.
launches.body:
Hi, we're Sanchit and Shubham, co-founders of RunAnywhere (W26), and we're launching Wally: our inference stack for open frontier models, hosted on our GPUs or deployed on yours.

<https://youtu.be/m_T2Diow3_M>

**TL;DR:** Wally serves GLM-5.3 Flash at 380 tokens per second with a 274 ms first token, faster than any endpoint on Artificial Analysis (Sep 28, 2026). New models land on day zero: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro was ready to serve about 8 hours after its weights dropped, and runs at 3x the speed of Xiaomi's own API (Artificial Analysis, Sep 21, 2026). The same stack deploys on-prem/BYOC at the same speed. [Sign up](https://runwally.com) and get $5 in free credits.

## The problem

Frontier models are slow and expensive, and you feel it most in products that run a model in a loop. A voice agent has a few hundred milliseconds before a turn feels broken. A coding agent waits for the first token on every tool call, dozens of times per task.

## How Wally works

Wally is our inference stack for open frontier models: our own kernels, speculative decoding, and prefill kept off the decode path so a long prompt never stalls someone else's stream. We tune it per model and per traffic pattern. It runs in two places.

**Hosted by us.** An OpenAI-compatible endpoint on our own GPUs, so anything that takes a base URL and a key works unchanged. Standard per-token pricing. Live today:

* **GLM-5.3 Flash:** 380 tok/s
* **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash:** 615 tok/s
* **Qwen3.8-27B:** 485 tok/s
* **MiMo-V2.6-Pro:** 320 tok/s
* **GLM-5.3 Max:** 790 tok/s

**Deployed for you.** The same stack on GPUs you own, in your cloud account, or on a dedicated instance we run. Same speed, your own models and fine-tunes, your traffic stays in your environment, and at token-heavy volumes it costs less than paying per token.

## New models on day zero

MiMo-V2.6-Pro, the top open-weights model on Artificial Analysis (Sep 21, 2026), was ready and running 3x faster than anyone else in 8 hours after Xiaomi published the weights.

## The numbers

Artificial Analysis lists 19 providers serving the same GLM-5.3 Flash weights (Sep 24, 2026), and Wally is 8.6x faster than Z.ai. Same model; the only difference is how it's served. Ours: 380 tok/s and a 274 ms first token, measured the same way.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117440&key=user_uploads/725397/e68127c0-8f31-4fe8-bbe2-44f587f09e67)

## Beyond the benchmark

Benchmarks don't always match reality, so we ran a real prompt on four providers, three times: GLM-5.3 Flash in the same OpenCode harness on Wally, Nebius, Fireworks and Z.ai, all building a game at once.

<https://youtu.be/yc-KVBwuWC0>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117440&key=user_uploads/725397/eaf90b9c-3be5-405a-9177-cca618fe81ea)

The same model reasons more or less on the same prompt from run to run, on every provider, so finish times look close even when the work isn't. Tokens per second of wall clock is the stable number: Wally 213, Nebius 149, Fireworks 68, Z.ai 47, averaged across the runs.

## Get started

Paste this into your coding agent:

```
set up https://runanywhere.ai/SKILL.md
```

Works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop and OpenCode. $5 free on signup, no card. Standard per-token pricing after that.

## Why we built it

We spent nine months making open models fast on phones and laptops, with our own inference engines for Apple and Qualcomm chips ([runanywhere-sdks](https://github.com/RunanywhereAI/runanywhere-sdks?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=wally-launch), 10K+ GitHub stars). Our users kept needing models too big for the device, and nobody served open frontier models fast enough for a real-time loop. None of our work was specific to phones, so we pointed it at data-center GPUs.

## Our ask

* **If you run a voice or agent product and latency or the inference bill hurts,** email [founders@runanywhere.ai](mailto:founders@runanywhere.ai) and we'll make it faster.
* **If a customer has asked you for on-prem,** intro us. We deploy on their GPUs.
* **Try it** and tell us what broke: [runwally.com](https://www.runwally.com/)

[Docs](https://docs.runanywhere.ai/?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=wally-launch) · [X @RunAnywhereAI](https://x.com/RunAnywhereAI)

launches.title: RunAnywhere: The default way to run On-Device AI at scale
launches.tagline: One SDK + Control Plane to Deploy, Route, Update, and Observe On-Device AI – Offline-First, Hybrid-Smart, Fleet-Managed
launches.body:
We're [Sanchit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanchitmonga22/) and [Shubham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubham-malhotra-fg890a23a/), co-founders of [RunAnywhere](https://runanywhere.ai/) (W26).

**TL;DR:** Run Multi-modal AI fully on-device with one SDK and manage model rollouts + policies from a control plane.

We are already live and open source with [**\~10.1k stars on GitHub**](https://github.com/RunanywhereAI/runanywhere-sdks).

<https://youtu.be/N3x2bs4ri68>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97041&key=user_uploads/725397/86d47939-7caf-4e0f-8575-045ca2fd22bc)

### The Problem

Edge AI is inevitable — users want instant responses, full privacy (health, finance, personal data), and AI that actually works on planes, subways, or spotty rural connections.

But shipping it today is brutal:

* Every device (iPhone 14 vs Android flagship vs low-end) has wildly different memory, thermal limits, and accelerators.
* Teams waste quarters rebuilding model download/resume/unzip/versioning, lifecycle (load/unload without crashing), multi-engine wrappers (llama.cpp, ONNX, etc.), and cross-platform bindings
* No real observability — you're blind to fallback rates, per-device perf, crashes tied to model version

**Result:** most teams either give up on local AI or ship a brittle, hacked-together experience.

### The Solution: Complete AI Infrastructure

RunAnywhere isn't just a wrapper around a model. It is a full-stack infrastructure layer for on-device intelligence.

**1. The "Boring" Stuff is Built-in** We provide a unified API that handles model delivery (downloading with resume support), extraction, and storage management. You don't need to build a file server client inside your app.

**2. Multi-Engine & Cross-Platform** We abstract away the inference backend. Whether it's llama.cpp or ONNX etc, you use one standard SDK.

* iOS (Swift)
* Android (Kotlin)
* React Native
* Flutter

**3. Hybrid Routing (The Control Plane)** We believe the future isn't "Local Only"—it's **Hybrid**. RunAnywhere allows you to define policies: try to run the request locally for zero latency/privacy; if the device is too hot, too old, or the confidence is low, automatically route the request to the cloud.

![Voice AI Pipeline Demo](/media/?type=post&id=97041&key=user_uploads/725397/dfe1b180-e5d8-4c59-a4e8-2109d9f903f2)

### Quick Links

* **OSS SDKs:** [github.com/RunanywhereAI/runanywhere-sdks](https://github.com/RunanywhereAI/runanywhere-sdks) (star if it vibes!)
* **Full Docs:** [docs.runanywhere.ai](https://docs.runanywhere.ai)
* **Website:** [runanywhere.ai](https://runanywhere.ai)

**Try our demo apps:**

* [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runanywhere.runanywhereai)

### Our Ask

We're in full execution mode post-launch and hunting design partners + early feedback:

* Building voice AI, offline agents, privacy-sensitive features (health/enterprise/consumer), or hybrid chat in your mobile/edge app?
* Want to eliminate cloud inference costs for repetitive queries while keeping complex ones fast?
* Have a fleet where OTA model updates + observability would save you engineering months?

**Get in touch:**

* Drop us a line: [san@runanywhere.ai](mailto:sanchit@runanywhere.ai)
* Book a quick call: [calendly.com/sanchitmonga22](https://calendly.com/sanchitmonga22)
* Or just tell us what sucks about your current on-device AI stack — honest war stories help us prioritize.

Excited to hear what you're building and how we can make on-device AI actually shippable at scale.
